facts.fact: Kunal's fingertips, struck by the broken 'ask nothing back' promise, go waxy, then grey, then blister and stay dead; fire and touch do not warm them. His last finger joints lag when he closes his hand. Revises F553's 'chill drains over time'.

Ila tells Kunal aloud that the Meadow Cairn's thaw dates give a hard year weeks and a soft year fewer; Kunal chooses to push the Eye tonight for her date, not only Raghu's. They plan to rope the hard moves in the cleft, Ila leading, Kunal holding with the palm.
